name: Damian Chabracki
role: Full-Stack Software Engineer | TypeScript, Node.js, Python, C#

domains.title: Critical Infrastructure
domains.text: At Proffico: **security by design** for **SCADA/HMI**-class telemetry and field apps for water infrastructure, built to **NIS2** standards: contract-first APIs with strict runtime validation, code reviews, unit tests, **WCAG** accessibility and performance tuning for large real-time data volumes.

domains.title: B2B & SaaS Products
domains.text: **Multi-tenancy by design:** a B2B platform and logistics marketplace in one `Turborepo` monorepo, built as a **modular monolith** with clean boundaries, client portal, admin panel, invoicing and Kanban automation, plus SEO-ready websites for SME clients.

domains.title: Frontend, Desktop & Mobile
domains.text: `React`, `Next.js` (hybrid **SSR / SSG**) and strict `TypeScript` with `Tailwind CSS`, **accessibility-first** (`WCAG 2.2 AA`). State with `TanStack Query`; desktop in `Electron`, field apps in `React Native`, real-time charts in `ECharts`, maps in `Mapbox GL`.

domains.title: Backend & Data Layer
domains.text: **API-first** backends with `NestJS` and `Node.js`: **state-machine-driven** workflows, a **double-entry ledger**, relational `SQL` (`PostgreSQL`) and `MongoDB` modeling via `Prisma`, `OpenAPI` contracts, `RBAC` enforced in the API layer and rate-limited public APIs.

domains.title: Cloud & DevOps
domains.text: **Shift-left delivery:** `GitHub Actions` run type checks, linting and tests (`Jest`, `Vitest`) before every deploy to `Microsoft Azure` or a `Linux VPS` (`Docker`, `Nginx`), with `Turborepo` monorepos and `Grafana` **observability**.

domains.title: Applied AI & ML
domains.text: `Python` ML (`Pandas`, `NumPy`) exposed through REST APIs: automated KYC identity-document verification and a real-time text-autocompletion NLP model with 95% prediction accuracy. Daily agentic engineering with `Claude Code CLI` and `Gemini`.

featured.title: personal-finance-manager
featured.text: Personal finance app: income and expenses by category, balance and spending charts, plus a one-click demo. **Firebase** sign-in (e-mail, Google), REST API on `Cloud Run` with `Firestore` and `Swagger` docs.

featured.title: personal-finance-manager-api
featured.text: REST API of the finance app: `Express` on `Cloud Run` verifies **Firebase** ID tokens and keeps each user's transactions in `Firestore`. `Joi` validation, `Swagger` docs, deployed by Actions with **no keys**.

featured.title: tmdb-movie-browser
featured.text: Movie browser on the `TMDb` API: search, trailers and watchlists in vanilla **JavaScript**. Pagination, local storage and a responsive layout, built with `Parcel` and `SASS`, **deployed by GitHub Actions**.

featured.title: ieee754-conversion-simulator
featured.text: Console simulator of the decimal to 64-bit **IEEE 754** conversion in `C#` and `.NET 8`, built from logic gates, a full adder, an `ALU` and a CPU model, with a hand-written parser and **28** `xUnit` tests.

featured.title: cafe-management-system
featured.text: Console cafe system in `Java`: a 16-product menu, orders with statuses, four payment methods, sorted history and sales statistics. An **OOP** showcase with `inheritance`, `interfaces`, `enums` and `generics`.

featured.title: id-verification
featured.text: Python scripts for a basic ID-document check: image pre-processing and **OCR** with `Tesseract` plus a declared-country match, `OpenCV` Haar face detection and a `scikit-learn` SVM sign classifier. A learning project.

featured.title: next-word-prediction
featured.text: Next-word prediction in `PyTorch`: a bidirectional **LSTM** trained on `NLTK`-preprocessed text corpora, with the warm-ups before it: tensors and an `MNIST` network. Suggests the word that follows 5 or 10 words.

featured.title: food-brand-landing-page
featured.text: Mobile-first landing page of a food brand: product modals, a gallery and a `Swiper` reviews slider. **BEM** and `SASS`, built with `Parcel` and **deployed by GitHub Actions** to `GitHub Pages`.

featured.title: digital-agency-website
featured.text: Two-page site of a web agency: offer, team, skills and a nine-project portfolio. **BEM** and `SASS`, responsive `@1x` to `@3x` images, a mobile menu and a modal in `JavaScript`, hosted on `GitHub Pages`.

featured.title: rikigo
featured.text: Marketplace for oversized cargo: customers set a price, carriers accept or bid, the platform settles payments. Core with a **state machine** and a **double-entry ledger**, in `Next.js`, `TypeScript` and `PostgreSQL`.

featured.title: pogotowieglazurnicze
featured.text: Site for a renovation firm in Katowice: four service lines, a free-quote form and tap-to-call on every screen. **Lighthouse 100/100/100**, `WCAG 2.2 AA` tests, built with `Next.js`, `Tailwind` and `Zod`.

featured.title: czarymaryokulary
featured.text: Redesigned site of a Warsaw optical salon: offer, news and directions in a few clicks, light/dark mode. **Lighthouse 100** performance and SEO, **97** accessibility, built with `Next.js` and `Tailwind`.

featured.title: damreboot
featured.text: Company platform: offer site, client portal with **CRM** and wallet, and this CV portfolio, as one `Turborepo` monorepo on a shared `MongoDB` layer. **Self-hosted** with `Docker` and `Caddy`.

featured.title: souler
featured.text: Portfolio of a young fashion designer: collections as lookbooks, a rental box that sends one inquiry, Polish and English. **No cookies, no tracking**, `WCAG 2.2 AA` tests with `Next.js` and `Playwright`.

featured.title: karcar
featured.text: Site of a premium-car workshop in Warsaw: services, makes, social news pulled at build time, quote forms. A **static export** with a scroll-driven ECG line, `WCAG 2.2 AA` tests, `Next.js` and `Firebase`.
